note_on_scoping: Decision B-1 scopes the mechanical assertions to the installed package, with an explicit allowlist rather than a silent skip, so that every exclusion is auditable. B-1' confirms operationally that the Colab and passive trees are never imported or installed by the orchestrator. Every S0.2 target is scope 'colab' or 'passive', verdict 'retain' -- none of them enters the package. ast.parse is nevertheless required of all ten, because a file that does not parse cannot be inspected by any downstream tool, whatever its scope.

The file has never been py_compile-able and is not required to be: passive scope, verdict retain, never imported by the orchestrator and never installed.
